# AIConsult.ch

> AIConsult.ch is a Swiss AI consultancy (KI-Beratung) run by Adrian Althaus in Schlieren near Zurich. It offers fixed-price AI consulting, AI training for employees (KI-Schulung) and workflow automation for SMEs (KMU) in Zurich and German-speaking Switzerland, with a specialisation in sales, retail and e-commerce. Website language: German (formal "Sie").

## Who is behind it

- Adrian Althaus, founder and consultant (Althaus Online, sole proprietorship, UID CHE-496.054.967, Brandstrasse 25, 8952 Schlieren, Switzerland)
- Long-standing practical experience in sales, key account management, product and category management in Swiss retail, plus e-commerce
- Competences: AI in sales and key account management, sell-out analysis, forecasting, pricing and promotion planning, e-commerce automation, AI usage policies under the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG)
- CAS AI Management, HWZ Zurich (2026)

## Offers (fixed prices, CHF)

- KI-Startpaket: Schulung und Richtlinie (CHF 2'400, up to 12 participants, suitable for any SME team): AI usage policy oriented on the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG), 3-hour workshop with the company's own use cases, attendance confirmation as training record, 30 days of email questions
- Workshop "KI im Vertrieb & Key Account Management" (CHF 2'200, half day, up to 12 participants): sell-out reporting and market analysis with AI, preparing annual negotiations with retail buyers, quotes and follow-ups
- E-Commerce-Automatisierung (from CHF 3'800): analysis plus 1–2 automations for Shopify shops (product data, inventory, customer emails) in the existing systems
- Sparring for management and sales leadership: CHF 220 per hour
- Free 30-minute potential check ("Potenzialcheck")
- Larger integration projects: together with specialised partners

## Good fit

- Any SME (3–200 employees) in Zurich and German-speaking Switzerland that wants to introduce AI safely and train its team
- Importers and brand distributors (e.g. beverages, food, sports, household, beauty) with 3–200 employees
- Online retailers and Shopify merchants in Switzerland
- Sales and key account teams that want to use AI with their own data
